candidate.answerReason: Combining the equal exponents gives \((-1)^{2025}=-1\), since 2025 is odd.

methods.label: Combine equal exponents
methods.explanation: Applying the power-of-a-product rule in reverse: \((-2)^{2025}\times(1/2)^{2025}=(-2\times1/2)^{2025}=(-1)^{2025}=-1\).
methods.levelReason: Uses the product-power rule for a positive integer exponent and the elementary sign rule for odd powers.
